description: This Java source file defines the implementation of a builder class for creating responses and events related to modifying feature properties in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains inner classes for response and event factory implementations, and methods for creating different response types according to command outcomes.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: An implementation of a builder for creating command responses and event objects for modifications of feature properties, following a fluent API pattern.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Inner class implementing response factory methods to create different response types based on command outcomes.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Inner class implementing event factory methods to generate event objects indicating creation or modification of feature properties.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for a specific command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Generates a CommandResponse using the provided factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Generates an Event object using the provided factory function.
